resampling_unit: HAM split_group, sampled with replacement in sorted group order using NumPy PCG64
estimand: analysis-unit-weighted paired difference (candidate minus reference); each sampled group carries all its analysis units
conditioning: fixed training support, temperature, calibration thresholds and test cohort; no fit or policy reselection during resampling
base_contrast: Climbing versus Flat, selected under the original joint 16-slot calibration grid
extended_contrasts: each of the other five method families versus maximum-probability Flat at the same backbone, readout and temperature
classification_diagnostic: unrestricted cosine centroid versus frozen text, using native scores
across_splits: unweighted mean of the three split point estimates, with intervals reported per split because the test groups overlap
